gloss: ready to eat; ripe for eating; at its best for eating

definitions.gloss: ready to eat; at peak ripeness; at its best for eating
definitions.explanation: The ideal state or timing for eating something, especially fruit or other produce that reaches peak flavor and texture at a certain point of ripeness.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}だ。
examples.english: This banana is just ready to eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{置|お}いたら→置く：01092_oku⟧{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you leave it a bit longer, it will be ready to eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きたら{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧だ。
examples.english: When peaches start to soften, that's a sign they're ready to eat.

notes:
Composed of the verb stem ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to eat) and the suffix ⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧ (suitable time, peak). The suffix ～⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧ attaches to verb stems to indicate the ideal time or condition for that action.

RELATED ～{頃|ごろ} WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}{頃|ごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧: at its best for viewing (flowers, scenery)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}→飲み頃：26569_nomigoro⟧: at its best for drinking (wine, tea)
- {読|よ}み{頃|ごろ}: good for reading; page count that's easy to finish
- {買|か}い{頃|ごろ}: good time to buy; reasonably priced

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧: fruit that is ripe and ready to eat
- {食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become ready to eat
- ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}: just at the right time for eating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧: in season — focuses on seasonal availability rather than individual ripeness
- ⟦{熟|じゅく}した→熟す：18384_jukusu⟧: ripe, mature — describes the state of the food itself
